Show HN: OpenComputer – an open source alternative to Devin
articles.text: Hi HN! Utpal here, I'm one of the founders of OpenComputer. OpenComputer is an open source cloud coding agent for teams that can run in your own cloud account (AWS, GCP, Azure). We run the agent harness and the sandbox on the same durable VM (architecture in the docs [1]). First commit lands in 24s; the alternatives we benchmarked took 53-72s (benchmarks below [2]). Two other choices: - One VM per team, scalable horizontally. Sessions are isolated in git worktrees. - Session files are backe
